quotes.text: Link is compatible with both the [Invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices.md) and [Subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions.md) APIs.
Your customers can pay invoices faster using Link as a payment method to autofill their payment details.
The hosted invoice page provides a secure, private URL where your customers can view, pay, and download copies of the invoice.
Find Link, toggle it on, and click **Save**.
After you enable Link in the hosted invoice page, all of your customers can pay their invoices faster using Link.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/invoicing, the November capture describes Stripe’s hosted invoice page with Link autofill. Stripe supplies a unique private invoice URL that customers can use to view, pay and download the invoice. Enable Link in Dashboard under Invoice template → Payment methods → Manage, toggle Link on, and save. This hosted setup requires no extra implementation code and is compatible with the Invoices and Subscriptions APIs (new raw lines 7-25 and old raw lines 6-24). The May capture documents the same behavior, and `source-stripe-invoicing-link.md` lines 13–20 records the steps, API compatibility and page behavior. Its ‘zero implementation changes’ shorthand needs the hosted scope. The separately linked integration guide limits display to eligible transactions, the Invoicing payment methods table lists Link for most currencies and locations and supports invoice-specific configuration, and the Invoice object documents that the hosted URL is null before finalization. An accessible URL, Link display or autofill is distinct from a paid invoice or successful settlement.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/invoicing, November changes casing, captions, screenshot reference, whitespace and list numbering. The same setup, UI, API compatibility and product wording remain (old raw lines 6-24 and new raw lines 7-25). Keep the May screenshot and collection attribution dated in `source-stripe-invoicing-link.md`. Both captures say ‘all of your customers’ after enablement. Qualify that wording on the mapped source and the reciprocal Link concept Invoicing route. The Invoicing payment methods guide scopes Link to most currencies and business locations, with separate invoice overrides, and the linked Link integration guide scopes display to eligible transactions. Funding options have additional business, amount, currency, location and recurring/off-session filters. Keep the Dashboard toggle and no-extra-code statement specific to Stripe’s hosted page. Invoices and Subscriptions API compatibility supplies no API or SDK version change, specific PaymentMethod representation, automatic renewal or successful charge. The separate Invoice object and hosted invoice guide distinguish URL availability after finalization, URL expiration and invoice status.
